title: The tech story check mark is removed everywhere, including Simple Flow
custom_preconds:
1. You are signed in on the Work Orders build under test with Work Orders view permission; the Board View and Tech View display options are on.
  2. The current location has at least 3 lead technicians shown as groups/columns (a technician is eligible when they are Clockable, Active, and their role is not Office or Time Clock User).
  3. Via New Work Order, create several work orders and set a Lead Technician on each, spread across the technicians with some left Unassigned; then open the Work Orders page.
  4. A work order with a line that has a tech story entered.
  5. Existing coverage: app/src/components/ts/work-orders/work-order-lines/tests/WorkOrderLineRow.spec.ts › “renders the story text without a check mark for a line with a tech story”
custom_steps:
1. Open the work order line list.
  2. Confirm no check-mark indicator appears for the line with a tech story.
  3. Open the Simple Flow tech-view mode and confirm the indicator is gone there too.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • The check mark that appeared on a work-order line when a tech story was entered is gone everywhere it used to show, including the Simple Flow tech-view mode.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-10043 (Work Orders — Board View & Tech View Display Options). Story reference: SV-10051 — Story 8 Remove tech-story check-mark. Spec: Confluence page 845185030 “Work Orders — Board View & Tech View Display Options (Draft Spec)”, Draft v0.9, requirement(s) S8-R1 (read 23 Sep 2026). Review decisions/answers: Confluence page 853901313 where cited. Source-verified on 23 September 2026; not yet build-verified.
